input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "recruit" and "induce" across the Agreement return no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding Customer; the General section (30) and Confidentiality contain none. To the contrary, clause 12.3 expressly confirms Customer is free to hire any person responding to general recruitment and has given no no-hire commitment. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), and clause 12.3 benefits us, so no redline is warranted.
